description: Five EU readings for build/eu. Each quote is one line of the given SmPC section file. It first appears in the English Annex I of first_decision and is absent from the annex of absent_before, the previous converted decision of the same product. Checked against the PDF page text (PyMuPDF, whitespace collapsed, no converter) of both annexes, identified by SHA-256 in raw/eu/sha256/, and against build/eu by tools/tests/test_eu.py KnownReadingsTest.

readings.name: Ziagen
readings.quote: In addition, two retrospective, case-controlled pharmacogenetic studies have shown that carriage of HLA-B*5701 is associated with a significantly increased risk of clinically suspected hypersensitivity in Caucasians.
readings.reading: On 2006-11-28 Ziagen section 4.4 carries the quoted sentence; the annex of decision (2005) 4388 (2005-11-07), in force until then, does not.

readings.name: Taxotere
readings.quote: Cystoid macular oedema (CMO) has been reported in patients treated with docetaxel.
readings.reading: On 2014-02-06 Taxotere section 4.4 carries the quoted sentence; the annex of decision (2012) 5276 (2012-07-20), in force until then, does not.

readings.name: Jardiance
readings.quote: Rare cases of diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA), including life-threatening cases, have been reported in clinical trials and post-marketing in patients treated with SGLT2 inhibitors, including empagliflozin.
readings.reading: On 2016-04-25 Jardiance section 4.4 carries the quoted sentence; the annex of decision (2015) 9548 (2015-12-14), in force until then, does not.

readings.name: Keytruda
readings.quote: KEYTRUDA is indicated for the treatment of locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung carcinoma (NSCLC) in adults whose tumours express PD-L1 and who have received at least one prior chemotherapy regimen.
readings.reading: On 2016-07-29 Keytruda section 4.1 carries the quoted sentence; the annex of decision (2015) 5144 (2015-07-17), in force until then, does not.

readings.name: Ozempic
readings.quote: Cases of pulmonary aspiration have been reported in patients receiving GLP-1 receptor agonists undergoing general anaesthesia or deep sedation.
readings.reading: On 2025-09-17 Ozempic section 4.4 carries the quoted sentence; the annex of decision (2024) 3991 (2024-06-10), in force until then, does not.
